column15: Rose Peak is an energetic, multi-genre fusion rock quintet formed in late 2023 at the University of Washington in Seattle. Known for combining 1970s classic rock sensibilities with modern jazz-fusion, funk, psychedelic rock, and blues, the band has quickly established a strong footprint in the Pacific Northwest local scene.
